title: ArtifactDeliveredData
description: data of artifact.delivered (PRD 9.5): a deliverable reached the Delivery Dock. This event is the notice, not the side effect, so it carries no authz. A format that leaves Tilo (email, or google_docs, google_sheets or google_slides through the Drive connector, PRD 12.4) went through the outbox: outbox_id names the entry that sent it, and the event's cause is that entry's data.transfer out, which carries the authorisation (EV-14, HR-7). A format kept in Tilo (a file to download, or in_app) has outbox_id null.
